source_caption: Supplementary Table 2 | Tier-specific source and candidate coverage. Counts of cited candidates overlap between tiers: C048, C068 and C082 have citations in more than one tier. The union is 46 candidates and 30 original citation sources, represented by 53 deduplicated candidate–evidence links. The RP-cited-source column describes the 28-record core graph, in which Tiers 3 and 4 contribute through original candidate citations. Source support in the dated review layer is reported separately and is not included in that column.
principle_interpretation: Mechanistic status: source-specific observations establish precursor-, steric- and site-dependence. Coupling these observations to catalyst compatibility is a conditional design rationale; it is not a universal kinetic relationship. Specific P/Se compatibility comparisons are documented in Sections S2.5–S2.6 and the repository guide to interpreting experimental records (docs/interpretation.md).

The four current cards specify a relationship, directional implications, supporting evidence, source scope, exceptions and candidate-generation rules. RP1 concerns access to a fluorinated acceptor; RP2 couples donor availability to capture competence; RP3 relates intermediate state to fluorine loss or retention; RP4 relates selective formation to subsequent consumption. Twenty-eight distinct evidence records connect the four current cards to eight sources. A candidate-level crosswalk records how each relationship poses an activation, capture, endpoint or persistence question for the 100 structures. It is an explanatory mapping, not a trained prediction model.
